name: Friday-OS Master Registry
description: Ground-truth inventory of verified Agents, Skills, and Native Tools in Friday OS

friday-prime.name: F.R.I.D.A.Y. Prime
friday-prime.description: Primary real-time speech-to-speech, vision, and intent routing agent powered by Gemini 3.1 Flash Live and Gemini 3.7 Flash.

prime-agent.name: Prime Agent
prime-agent.role: Primary Autonomous Software Engineer & Coding Agent
prime-agent.description: Dedicated coding agent (PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent). Specializes in software engineering, refactoring, building projects, writing code, and debugging.

hermes.name: Hermes Intelligence Agent
hermes.description: Delegated sub-agent for autonomous web research, Obsidian vault queries, file operations, and general problem solving via Hermes CLI.

ultron.name: Ultron OS Diagnostics & Boost Engine
ultron.description: Diagnostic daemon for Linux OS health audits, CPU thermal monitoring, memory optimization, and sound server auto-healing.

get_weather_forecast.name: get_weather_forecast
get_weather_forecast.description: Fetches current real-time meteorological conditions, temperature, humidity, wind, and 3-day forecast via Open-Meteo API.

get_news_headlines.name: get_news_headlines
get_news_headlines.description: Pulls latest curated breaking headlines from Google News RSS feeds across world, technology, business, science, or custom queries.

category.description: News category: world, technology, business, science, sports, entertainment, health

manage_reminders.name: manage_reminders
manage_reminders.description: Creates, lists, completes, or clears scheduled reminders. Monitored by the 24/7 proactive heartbeat.

due_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now when reminder should trigger

calculate_or_convert.name: calculate_or_convert
calculate_or_convert.description: Evaluates complex mathematical expressions and physical unit conversions.

get_personal_agenda.name: get_personal_agenda
get_personal_agenda.description: Retrieves today's personal agenda, due reminders, active multi-agent workflows, and proactive next-step recommendations.

manage_daily_schedule.name: manage_daily_schedule
manage_daily_schedule.description: Creates, lists, completes, or clears scheduled milestones and priority items on the daily personal agenda.

delegate_task.name: delegate_task
delegate_task.description: Intelligently delegates tasks to the specialist agent best suited: Prime Agent (coding/testing), Hermes (research/vault), or Ultron (system/optimization).

delegate_to_prime_agent.name: delegate_to_prime_agent
delegate_to_prime_agent.description: Dispatches intensive coding, software engineering, debugging, and refactoring tasks to Prime Agent.

context.description: Optional file paths or context snippets

delegate_to_hermes.name: delegate_to_hermes
delegate_to_hermes.description: Delegates multi-turn autonomous web research, notes synthesis, or file exploration to Hermes CLI.

delegate_to_ultron.name: delegate_to_ultron
delegate_to_ultron.description: Engages Ultron for deep Linux OS health audits, performance tuning, and hardware diagnostic analysis.

get_system_info.name: get_system_info
get_system_info.description: Retrieves ground-truth system telemetry (CPU usage %, RAM, disk space, battery status, thermals, uptime).

control_system.name: control_system
control_system.description: Adjusts master audio volume, display brightness, power management profiles, or executes power states.

launch_application.name: launch_application
launch_application.description: Launches desktop applications, terminals, browsers, IDEs, or media tools on the Linux host.

app_name.description: Name or binary of the application to launch

manage_system_process.name: manage_system_process
manage_system_process.description: Lists top running processes by CPU/Memory consumption, or terminates runaway tasks.

obsidian_search.name: obsidian_search
obsidian_search.description: Searches Markdown notes, diary entries, research logs, and facts in the personal Obsidian vault (`friday-memory/`).

obsidian_read.name: obsidian_read
obsidian_read.description: Reads the Markdown content and frontmatter of a specific note from the vault.

path.description: Relative file path within the vault

obsidian_create.name: obsidian_create
obsidian_create.description: Creates a new Markdown note in the user's sovereign Obsidian vault with metadata frontmatter.

obsidian_append.name: obsidian_append
obsidian_append.description: Appends timestamped notes, research findings, or task logs to an existing Markdown note.

sys_telemetry.description: Sub-millisecond CPU %, RAM, and load average extractor

hardware_ctrl.description: ALSA audio volume and screen backlight controller

pc_spec.description: Hardware motherboard, GPU, CPU, and RAM spec analyzer

process_ctrl.description: Process inspection, top consumers, and signal manager

service_ctrl.description: systemd daemon and background service controller

storage_scan.description: Partition mount and storage health scanner

net_inspector.description: Active socket connections, bandwidth, and interface status

wifi_scan.description: Wireless network scanner and signal strength analyzer

firewall_audit.description: iptables/ufw rule auditor and port listener scanner

desktop_control.description: X11/Wayland mouse, keyboard, and window automation

desktop_ctrl.description: Fast window focus and desktop workspace switcher

open_app.description: Desktop application launcher via XDG desktop entries

memory_tester.description: RAM bandwidth and memory cache benchmark tool

vision_ctrl.description: V4L2 camera device capture and display manager

audio_gateway.description: Zero-GC microsecond-latency audio engine. Captures 16kHz microphone PCM and plays 24kHz speaker PCM over Unix Domain Sockets without a browser.

memory_engine.description: Axum REST & WebSocket memory server with SQLite WAL (11 tables), FTS5 full-text search, and knowledge graph traversal.

telegram_notifier.description: Direct Telegram Bot API client for alerting the user on mobile when away from the browser.

telegram_bot.description: Long-polling Telegram bot enabling control (/status, /task, /remind, chat) directly from mobile.

heartbeat_engine.description: Background tick scheduler monitoring due reminders, battery drops, thermal spikes, and completed background tasks.

capability_forge.description: Bubblewrap (bwrap) sandboxed virtual environment for dynamically creating, compiling, and testing custom Python tools on the fly.
